stage: POLARIS STAGE 8.14B — UPWIND / LOCAL CLOUD OBSERVABILITY FEASIBILITY
research_question: Can POLARIS obtain a causally available, empirically observable, spatially representative measurement of the actual cloud state/evolution upwind or locally around Nuolja that contains information not already represented by the frozen Stage 8.1 feature set?

audit_findings_summary.top_candidate: EUMETSAT NWC SAF PPS Cloud Microphysics (CMIC)
top_candidate_blocking_factors: Retrospective 2024 open archive for L2 CMIC swaths is incomplete on open THREDDS endpoints
Optical channel retrievals fail during polar night (SZA > 84°)
Maximum usable coverage capped at 60.5% of benchmark origins

candidates.variable: Cloud fraction / cloud opacity / sky image
candidates.blocking_reason: No continuous calibrated all-sky camera feed was deployed or archived for Nuolja in 2024.
candidates.source_references: SITES Data Portal / Stage 8.9A Audit Report

candidates.spatial_representativeness: POOR (88.4 km separation across Scandes ridge)
candidates.upwind_relevance: POOR (Inland plateau vs mountain fjord valley microclimate)
candidates.blocking_reason: 88.4 km spatial separation across Scandes mountain ridge barrier; non-representative of Nuolja mountain microclimate.
candidates.source_references: SMHI METAR Archive / Stage 8.9A Audit Report

candidates.variable: SW_IN_DIR, SW_IN_DIFF, Direct/Diffuse Ratio, Clearness Index Kt
candidates.spatial_representativeness: MODERATE (3.23 km ESE, 287 m lower elevation)
candidates.blocking_reason: Evaluated in Stage 8.3 cross-validation and REJECTED (+0.63 W/m² MAE degradation, failed 5/5 gates).

candidates.product: CLAAS-3 / NWC SAF GEO Cloud Products
candidates.variable: Cloud Mask, Cloud Top Height, Cloud Optical Thickness
candidates.resolution: 3.0 km at nadir (>12.9 km N-S at 68.36°N)
candidates.blocking_reason: Satellite Zenith Angle VZA = 76.54° at 68.36°N; causes theoretical >20.9 km parallax displacement and extreme footprint distortion.
candidates.source_references: EUMETSAT NWC SAF GEO User Manual / Stage 8.9A Audit Report

candidates.variable: Cloud Optical Thickness (COT), Effective Radius (CER), Cloud Phase
candidates.polar_night_behavior: BLOCKED (Optical COT/CER fail during polar night SZA > 84°)
candidates.blocking_reason: Publication latency of standard science L2 files is 3–8 hours post-acquisition (t_pub > t0), yielding 0/347 operationally causal origins in real-time. Optical retrievals fail during polar night.
candidates.source_references: Stage 8.4 VIIRS Report / Stage 8.9A Audit Report

candidates.candidate: EUMETSAT NWC SAF PPS Cloud Microphysics
candidates.variable: Cloud Optical Thickness (COT), LWP, IWP, Cloud Top Height
candidates.publication_causality: CONDITIONALLY VERIFIED (Operational NWC SAF run takes ~30-60 min)
candidates.polar_night_behavior: BLOCKED (Optical retrievals return fill values during polar night)
candidates.information_novelty: PARTIALLY NOVEL (Observed COT vs model LWP/IWP)
candidates.existing_route_overlap: Stage 8.2 Candidate B & Stage 8.9A Candidate B3
candidates.blocking_reason: Retrospective 2024 open HTTP archive for L2 CMIC swaths is incomplete on open THREDDS endpoints; optical channel retrievals fail during polar night (max 60.5% coverage).
candidates.source_references: Stage 8.2 Feasibility Report / Stage 8.9A Audit Report

candidates.candidate: EUMETSAT NWC SAF PPS Atmospheric Motion Vectors
candidates.variable: Cloud motion velocity vector (u_cloud, v_cloud), Cloud Top Pressure
candidates.spatial_representativeness: POOR (Extremely sparse vector density over Scandes mountains)
candidates.information_novelty: GENUINELY NOVEL (Observed Cloud Motion vs U700/V700)
candidates.evidence_confidence: HIGH (NWC SAF PPS User Guide Audit)
candidates.blocking_reason: Dual-swath overlap processing delay prevents real-time causal availability (t_pub > t0). Extremely sparse vector retrieval over mountain terrain yields only 13.8% empirical coverage.
candidates.source_references: NWC SAF PPS AMV User Manual / Stage 8.9A Audit Report

candidates.spatial_representativeness: POOR (Beam blockage by Scandes mountains at 68.36°N)
candidates.upwind_relevance: POOR (Radar beam elevation >2.0 km over Nuolja due to distance/terrain blockage)
candidates.blocking_reason: Radar beam is blocked by Scandes mountain terrain and overshoots lower/mid tropospheric cloud layer over Nuolja. Radar measures precipitation reflectivity, not non-precipitating cloud optical attenuation.

candidates.variable: Specific cloud water, specific cloud ice on 65 pressure/hybrid levels
candidates.information_type: NWP Model-Derived Vertical Cloud Condensate Profile
candidates.site_or_footprint: MEPS 2.5 km Grid Cell Over Nuolja
candidates.information_novelty: DUPLICATE / MODEL-DERIVED (Stage 6.6 LWP/IWP already integrates this profile)
candidates.blocking_reason: Model-derived NWP forecast output, NOT an independent observational data source. Evaluated in Stage 8.0, 8.8, and 8.10.
